title: Senior Sales Manager (Current Account)
description:
**Job Requirements**
**About the Role**
 The
 **Senior Sales Manager – Current Account** 
 is a key leadership role within the
 **Retail Branch Banking** 
 function. The role is responsible for driving the growth and profitability of the current account portfolio across a defined region. This includes expanding the branch footprint, increasing product penetration, and ensuring the delivery of high\-quality customer service. The role bearer will lead a team of branch officers, identify high\-potential markets, and convert business opportunities into tangible results. With full P\&L accountability, this role directly contributes to the strategic objectives of the branch banking business.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of branch officers across the assigned branches.
* Identify and acquire potential customers for current accounts and asset products to generate fee\-based revenue.
* Monitor daily sales calls to ensure adherence to the acquisition process and adequate market coverage.
* Drive activation of current account clients and ensure achievement of float targets.
* Conduct regular product training and refreshers to ensure the team is well\-informed and up to date.
* Ensure timely and effective resolution of customer queries and service issues.
* Maintain optimal staffing levels and manage team attrition effectively.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by meeting service quality and delivery standards.
* Evaluate and refine growth strategies based on competitor analysis and customer feedback.
* Track business performance and ensure execution aligns with the defined business plan.


**Secondary Responsibilities**
* Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance service efficiency and quality across the branch network.
* Support employee engagement initiatives and foster a high\-performance culture.


**What We Are Looking For**
**Education**
* Graduate in any discipline.


**Experience**
* Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in sales within the banking industry, preferably in branch banking or current account acquisition.


**Skills And Attributes**
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Proven track record in sales and customer acquisition.
* Strategic thinking with a focus on execution and results.
* Ability to analyse market trends and competitor strategies.
* High customer orientation and service quality focus.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to attract, retain, and develop high\-performing talent.
* Fluent in English with strong business communication skills

title: Sales Engineer / Sales Manager – Instrumentation & Environmental Monitoring
description:

Ltd. is a leading provider of advanced control, automation, and environmental monitoring solutions, serving diverse industries, government bodies, municipalities, and institutional clients. With a strong commitment to innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, the company delivers cutting\-edge technologies that optimize processes, enhance operational efficiency, and support sustainable growth across sectors. 
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a proactive Sales Person with experience in Instrumentation and Environmental Monitoring solutions. The candidate will be responsible for business development, customer engagement, and achieving sales targets across industrial, environmental, and government sectors.

* Identify and develop new business opportunities for Instrumentation and Environmental Monitoring products.

* Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Systems (AAQMS)

* Effluent Quality Monitoring Systems (EQMS)

**Requirements** 



* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, Environmental Engineering, or related field.

* Willingness to travel for business development activities.



  





**Preferred Industry Experience** 



* Environmental Monitoring, Water \& Wastewater, and Government Projects.



  





**How To Apply
 
 ﻿**




 Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are invited to apply by sharing their updated CV at hr@aaxisnano.com.

title: Microsoft-MS-MS Dynamics and Sales Support-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Consulting \- Sales Support executive (Senior Manager):**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Sales Support executive (Senior Manager) is a key contributor to Consulting growth, responsible for supporting sales pursuits, proposal execution, and commercial analysis across priority opportunities. This role works closely with Senior Managers, Partners, Account Leaders, and solution teams to improve pursuit effectiveness, deal quality, and pipeline discipline.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Sales \& Pursuit Support
+ Support end to end sales pursuits for consulting opportunities, including qualification, proposal development, pricing support, and approvals.
+ Partner with pursuit leaders to help shape deal strategy, solution positioning, and client value propositions.
+ Maintain strong discipline on pipeline tracking, win probability updates, and pursuit milestones.


* Proposal \& RFP Management
+ Manage and coordinate RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and client presentations under guidance of Senior Managers and Partners.
+ Work with cross functional teams (solution architects, finance, legal, risk, delivery) to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely submissions.
+ Consolidate inputs, track dependencies, and ensure alignment between scope, commercials, and delivery approach.


* Commercial \& Financial Analysis
+ Support pricing models, effort estimates, margin analysis, and financial summaries for consulting deals.
+ Assist in preparing business cases, deal review materials, and approval documentation.
+ Analyse deal economics and highlight commercial risks, assumptions, and improvement opportunities.


* Sales Operations \& Governance
+ Ensure compliance with sales governance, review checkpoints, and approval workflows.
+ Support maintenance of sales support templates, trackers, and standard documentation.
+ Identify process gaps and contribute to continuous improvement of sales support operations.


* Stakeholder Management
+ Act as a primary working level contact for account teams and pursuit stakeholders.
+ Provide clear, structured updates on pursuit status, risks, and next steps.
+ Support leadership in pipeline reviews, forecast updates, and performance reporting.


* Team Collaboration \& Capability Building
+ Mentor Senior Consultants and Consultants within the sales support team.
+ Share best practices on proposal writing, commercial structuring, and pursuit management.
+ Contribute to knowledge assets, playbooks, and reusable pursuit collateral.


**Experience**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in consulting sales support, pursuit management, commercial advisory, or related roles.
* Hands on experience supporting medium to large consulting deals across technology, data, digital, or transformation programs.
* Experience working in a global / matrixed consulting environment is preferred.
* Should have strong AI understanding


**Core Competencies**
* Strong understanding of the consulting sales lifecycle and proposal processes.
* Working knowledge of pricing, effort estimation, and commercial constructs.
* Ability to synthesize complex inputs into clear, client ready deliverables.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.


**Behavioural \& Leadership Skills**
* Detail oriented with strong execution discipline.
* Comfortable operating in fast paced, deadline driven pursuit environments.
* Collaborative team player with emerging leadership capabilities.
* High standards of quality, compliance, and professionalism.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent is an advantage.


**What We Look For**
* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Deputy Manager Business Development
description:
**Company Description** 
 Optimized Electrotech Private Limited (OEPL) is an Indian electro‑optics company specializing in indigenously designed, developed, and manufactured surveillance systems for strategic and commercial clients. Founded in 2017, OEPL focuses on delivering cutting\-edge electro‑optic solutions tailored to the unique needs of the Indian defense sector. Its products are researched, tested, and deployed by leading land and aerospace organizations in India. OEPL aims to become a global leader in security solutions for national and international defense and aerospace organizations. The company is building a strong presence in homeland security, defense intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, and machine vision.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Deputy Manager Business Development is a full\-time, hybrid role based in Noida, with flexibility for some work\-from\-home arrangements. This role is responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities in defense, aerospace, and security markets, including prospecting, lead generation, and relationship management with key stakeholders. The Deputy Manager will support bid management and proposal development, prepare client presentations, and collaborate with technical teams to align solutions with customer requirements. Regular activities include travel to customer location, schedule meetings, market research, competitor analysis, sales pipeline tracking, and coordination with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate responses to client inquiries. The role also involves attending industry events, supporting contract negotiations, post sales activities and contributing to long\-term strategic growth plans.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Business development and sales skills, including lead generation, client relationship management, and pipeline management.
* Experience in defense, aerospace, security, or related technology sectors, with understanding of surveillance and electro‑optic solutions.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills for engaging with senior stakeholders and technical teams.
* Analytical and research abilities to conduct market analysis, track competitors, and identify emerging opportunities.
* Ability to conduct extensive travel and work in a hybrid environment, manage multiple projects, and collaborate effectively across functions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field; a postgraduate degree (MBA or equivalent) is an advantage.
* Proficiency with CRM tools, MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), and basic data reporting for business metrics.
* Prior experience in government or defense procurement processes and tendering is highly beneficial.

title: Account Executive
description:
About the Company
 



 TheHireHub.AI is a startup founded in 2025, building an AI\-driven recruitment platform that automates sourcing, screening, engagement, and coordination across the hiring process. Built on insights from more than 3,000 global hiring projects and over 20 years of executive search expertise, the platform helps mid\-market and growth\-stage companies hire faster and make smarter decisions. The company serves customers across India, APAC, and MEA, with a growing global footprint, and is headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana. TheHireHub.AI empowers recruiters by reducing administrative work and enabling them to focus on strategic decision\-making, customer relationships, and quality hiring outcomes. As a privately held, pre\-seed startup with a small team, it offers a dynamic and growth\-oriented environment for people who value ownership, adaptability, and innovation. The company’s mission is to transform recruitment through AI\-driven solutions, while its core values emphasize innovation, efficiency, empowerment, and an inclusive workplace. This role will contribute directly to expanding adoption of the platform and helping hiring teams improve recruitment effectiveness.
 



 About the Role
 



 As an Account Executive, you will own the customer journey from qualified opportunity through closure, onboarding coordination, account development, and long\-term relationship management. You will sell TheHireHub.AI’s B2B SaaS platform by understanding recruitment and HR technology challenges, connecting those needs to relevant product capabilities, and building a credible business case. The role requires strong prospecting, consultative selling, commercial judgment, and disciplined execution. You will manage a revenue pipeline, forecast accurately, coordinate internal stakeholders, and ensure customers receive consistent value after the sale. Cross\-selling and upselling are core expectations, alongside end\-to\-end client ownership. Experience in B2B SaaS sales is essential, while exposure to HR technology and artificial intelligence is preferred. This is an onsite role based in Noida.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Own the complete sales cycle from discovery and qualification through proposal, negotiation, closure, and transition into implementation, ensuring every stage advances measurable revenue outcomes.
* Build and manage a qualified enterprise pipeline through targeted prospecting, relationship development, referrals, and account research, maintaining consistent coverage against quarterly revenue goals.
* Lead consultative conversations with HR, recruitment, business, and technology stakeholders to identify challenges and position AI\-powered recruitment solutions around clear customer value.
* Develop and execute account expansion plans that increase customer lifetime value through relevant cross\-sell and upsell opportunities across products, teams, and use cases.
* Act as the primary commercial point of contact for assigned clients, coordinating internal teams to resolve issues, protect relationships, and support successful long\-term adoption.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity stages, next steps, and forecasts so leadership has reliable visibility into pipeline health, risks, and expected bookings.
* Collaborate with marketing, solutions, implementation, and customer success teams to improve win rates, shorten sales cycles, and strengthen the overall customer experience.



 Essential Skills \& Technologies
 


* 3–5 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, with demonstrated ownership of pipeline creation, consultative selling, negotiations, closures, and revenue delivery.
* Strong account management capability, including cross\-selling, upselling, stakeholder mapping, renewal support, and end\-to\-end client relationship ownership.
* Excellent discovery, presentation, communication, objection\-handling, negotiation, and business\-case development skills across enterprise buying groups.
* Working proficiency with CRM platforms and sales productivity tools, including opportunity management, activity tracking, forecasting, and structured pipeline reviews.
* Ability to understand and communicate HR technology, artificial intelligence, recruitment automation, and employee experience concepts in commercially relevant language.



 Additional Plus
 


* Experience selling HR technology, recruitment software, employee experience, automation, or AI\-enabled enterprise software to business customers.
* Existing relationships with HR, recruitment, people operations, shared services, IT, or transformation leaders within mid\-market and enterprise organizations.
* Experience working in an early\-stage or high\-growth SaaS environment where ownership, adaptability, and speed of execution directly influence commercial outcomes.



 What You'll Bring
 


* A proven B2B SaaS sales track record with the discipline to build pipeline, run structured sales cycles, close business, and consistently deliver against revenue expectations.
* A customer\-first commercial mindset that turns discovery into relevant recommendations, builds executive trust, and identifies expansion opportunities without compromising long\-term relationships.
* Strong ownership across the full client lifecycle, including internal coordination, expectation management, issue resolution, adoption support, and account growth.
* Curiosity about HR technology and artificial intelligence, combined with the ability to learn complex products quickly and explain their business impact with clarity.



 Why Join Us
 



 TheHireHub.AI offers the opportunity to join a startup founded in 2025 and sell an AI\-driven recruitment platform addressing important hiring efficiency and decision\-making challenges for growing businesses. You will engage with customers seeking faster, smarter, and more effective ways to manage the recruitment lifecycle.
 



 This role gives you meaningful ownership across acquisition, closure, account expansion, and client relationships rather than limiting your impact to a single stage of the funnel. Your work will directly influence revenue growth, customer value, and the company’s position in the evolving HR technology market.
 



 You will collaborate with a small, growth\-oriented team and gain broad exposure to enterprise SaaS execution, recruitment technology, artificial intelligence, and cross\-functional operations. The environment rewards initiative, customer understanding, structured selling, and people who take responsibility for outcomes.
 



 What We Offer
 


* Opportunity to sell an AI\-driven B2B SaaS platform helping hiring teams automate recruitment and improve the speed and quality of hiring decisions.
* Broad commercial ownership across new business, client relationships, cross\-selling, upselling, and account growth in a collaborative onsite Noida environment.
* Exposure to enterprise sales, HR technology, artificial intelligence, and cross\-functional SaaS operations within a growing global startup.
* Competitive compensation and the opportunity to grow with a company operating at the intersection of recruitment, automation, and intelligent hiring technology.

 The Right Mindset Matters More Than Experience
 
 We can teach you our products and sales process.
 



 What we cannot teach easily is the willingness to
 **pick up the phone, follow up, handle rejection and keep going** 
 .
 



 You should be someone who:
 



**Takes initiative** 




 You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do with every lead.
 



**Likes talking to people** 




 You are comfortable having conversations and building rapport.
 



**Is persistent** 




 You understand that the first conversation does not always result in a booking.
 



**Is commercially minded** 




 You care about results, not just completing tasks.
 



**Wants to grow in sales** 




 You see this as a career opportunity, not just a temporary job.
 


 What You Will Learn
 
 You will get practical exposure to:
 


* Lead qualification
* Consultative selling
* Sales calls
* WhatsApp sales
* Follow\-up systems
* Objection handling
* Negotiation
* Closing techniques
* CRM and pipeline management
* B2B business development
* Travel product sales


 Performance \& Growth

* Leads handled
* Follow\-ups completed

* Bookings generated
* Revenue generated

**Compensation:** 
 ₹15,000–₹20,000/month \+ performance incentives.
 



 High performers will have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and progress towards:
 



**Sales Executive → Senior Sales Executive → Business Development / Sales Manager** 



 Why Join Rovio Travels?

 , not simply sit behind a desk and process enquiries.
 



 You will get exposure to customers, negotiations, pricing, B2C sales, B2B sales and the commercial side of a growing travel business.
 



 Your results will be visible.

The ideal candidate will take ownership of monetizing our highly targeted industry forums by selling high\-value sponsorships, exhibition spaces, and corporate delegate passes.

 Competency in Microsoft Office, CRM software (HubSpot/Salesforce), and advanced usage of LinkedIn Sales Navigator for B2B prospecting.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
**Why this role exists** 




  





 Outbound isn't about sending more emails or making more calls. It's about systematically earning the right to have a sales conversation with the accounts that matter most.
 



  





 We're building a highly account centric outbound motion where BDRs don't own territories, they own relationships. Every account should feel researched, personalized, and intentionally worked across multiple stakeholders before an AE ever joins the conversation.
 



  





 We're looking for a Business Development Representative who treats outbound as a strategic discipline rather than an activity metric. Someone who enjoys breaking into complex accounts, understands how buying committees work, and knows that a well qualified opportunity creates far more value than a calendar full of meetings.
 



  





**What you'll actually do** 




  




* Own the outbound motion across your assigned accounts, building meaningful engagement rather than broad prospect coverage.
* Research organizations, map buying committees, identify economic buyers, champions, technical evaluators, and end users, and continuously enrich account intelligence that supports the AE's account strategy.
* Execute highly personalized multi channel outbound sequences across calls, email, and LinkedIn using platforms like Apollo and Salesloft, tailoring outreach based on buying signals and account context.
* Act quickly on intent signals, website activity, webinar engagement, product usage, and other outbound triggers to create timely, relevant conversations.
* Qualify opportunities using the TACT framework, capturing business pain, current state, incumbent solution, buying timeline, and expansion potential before creating pipeline.
* Partner closely with Account Executives through detailed meeting briefs, structured handoffs, and participation in customer conversations where continuity improves win probability.
* Support pipeline generation before and after webinars, events, and marketing campaigns through targeted outreach into assigned accounts rather than broad marketing follow\-up.
* Maintain exceptional CRM hygiene by documenting account activity, next steps, campaign attribution, and customer insights while continuously feeding market intelligence back to Sales and Marketing.



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* 3\-5 years of Outbound sales experience within B2B SaaS environments.
* Experience prospecting into mid\-market and enterprise accounts using structured outbound methodologies.
* Strong account research skills with the ability to identify buying committees, multithread accounts, and build strategic account plans.
* Hands\-on experience with outbound sales platforms such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Apollo, Sales Navigator, HubSpot, ZoomInfo, or similar tools.
* Excellent discovery and qualification skills with experience using frameworks such as TACT, MEDDPICC, BANT, or similar methodologies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to personalize outreach at scale.
* High ownership mindset with the discipline to manage pipeline, maintain CRM hygiene, and consistently execute against outbound goals.
* Comfortable working in a fast paced, high growth SaaS environment with ambitious sales targets.



  





**What We’ll Count on You For** 




  




* Drive outbound prospecting via cold calls, personalized emails, and LinkedIn outreach.
* Identify and engage ICP\-fit prospects through targeted research and discovery.
* Maintain high outreach activity and accurately track all actions in the CRM.
* Clearly articulate product value and position solutions against prospect pain points.
* Partner with AEs to ensure seamless handoff and pipeline progression.
* Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly lead and meeting targets.



  





**Edges that help** 




  




* You've successfully penetrated enterprise accounts through multithreaded outbound rather than relying on inbound leads.
* You've built outbound campaigns around buying signals, trigger events, and account intelligence instead of generic sequences.
* You've partnered closely with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle, creating detailed handoffs that improve conversion and deal progression.
* You have experience selling into EMEA or North American markets and understand enterprise buying behaviour.
* You're comfortable using AI tools to research accounts, personalize outreach, improve messaging, and increase outbound productivity.
* You've consistently exceeded outbound pipeline generation targets through disciplined execution and continuous experimentation.



  





**How we work** 




  




* Outcomes over activity \- We measure success by qualified pipeline, account penetration, conversion rates, and revenue influence, not just calls made or emails sent.
* High ownership from day one \- You'll own strategic accounts, not simply execute outreach tasks.
* Fast execution, continuous experimentation and constant iteration \- We value curiosity, customer understanding, and disciplined outbound execution.
* Competitive compensation tied to performance, ownership and the business impact you create.



  





**The bigger picture** 




  





 JustCall is SaaS Labs' flagship product \- used by 6,000\+ businesses across 70\+ countries to run their customer conversations. We're backed by Peak XV and Base10 Partners, have crossed $40M ARR, and are building toward $100M with the team, the product, and the infrastructure to get there.
 



  





 If this is the role you've been waiting to find \- let's talk.
 



  





 SaaS Labs takes pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products, which is why we're committed to making hiring or any employment decision regardless of race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

 Understand the customer problem → Design the solution → Connect the cameras → Configure the network → Deploy AI/VMS → Test the solution → Demonstrate results → Support the sales team → Convert the POC into a project.

title: Account Manager Sales
description:
**Job Description**
**Join Tsaaro as an Account Manager – Sales**
**Build Relationships. Drive Revenue. Strengthen Client Success.**
 Are you a client\-focused sales professional passionate about building long\-term relationships, driving account growth, and delivering value to customers? Looking for a role where your strategic engagement directly contributes to strengthening cybersecurity and privacy ecosystems?
   

  

 At Tsaaro, we go beyond compliance — we help organizations build trust, strengthen governance, and elevate their security posture. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an
 **Account Manager – Sales** 
 who excels at client retention, upselling, and nurturing strong business partnerships across industries.
   

  

**About Tsaaro**
 At Tsaaro, privacy and security aren’t support functions — they are the heart of our mission. As a specialized data privacy and cybersecurity consulting firm, we empower businesses to build resilient compliance frameworks, enhance governance, and demonstrate digital trust to their customers.
   

  

 Our Account Management team plays a critical role in developing strong customer relationships, ensuring smooth delivery, and identifying new opportunities that align with client needs.
   

  

**Your Role: Account Manager – Sales**
 As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing client accounts end\-to\-end — from onboarding and relationship building to renewals, upselling, and identifying new business opportunities. You will work closely with delivery teams, consulting teams, and leadership to ensure clients receive exceptional service and measurable value.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage and grow relationships with existing clients across privacy, cybersecurity, and GRC domains.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring timely communication and issue resolution.
* Understand client needs, business challenges, and industry context to offer relevant Tsaaro solutions.
* Drive upsell and cross\-sell opportunities across consulting services, training, assessments, and certifications.
* Collaborate with consulting and delivery teams to ensure high\-quality project execution.
* Manage renewals, contract extensions, and account expansions.
* Conduct quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with key clients to showcase progress and identify growth potential.
* Track account performance, revenue projections, and client engagement using CRM systems.
* Identify churn risks and implement proactive strategies to strengthen client retention.
* Coordinate with marketing and sales teams to support campaigns and client\-facing initiatives.
* Stay updated on privacy laws, cybersecurity trends, and market developments to add strategic value during client discussions.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related discipline.
* 4–6 years of experience in account management, client success, or B2B sales.
* Proven track record in managing enterprise accounts, renewals, and revenue growth.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience working with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Ability to collaborate across teams and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.
* Target\-driven, organized, and proactive with a strong ownership mindset.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience working in cybersecurity, data privacy, SaaS, or consulting environments.
* Understanding of GDPR, DPDP Act, CCPA, or global privacy/security frameworks.
* Exposure to consultative, value\-based, or solution\-selling models.
* Strong analytical mindset for understanding client data and account trends.
* Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or sales automation tools.
* Ability to conduct presentations, proposal discussions, and QBRs confidently.


**Benefits**
* Be part of one of India’s fastest\-growing privacy and cybersecurity consulting firms, managing key accounts that drive business impact.
* Gain deep exposure to privacy regulations (GDPR, DPDP Act) and cybersecurity frameworks while working closely with expert consulting teams.
* Opportunity to transition into Senior Account Manager or Account Director roles based on performance.
* Work directly with cross\-functional teams including consulting, legal, GRC, and marketing.
* Transparent, collaborative, and performance\-driven work culture.
* Access to advanced sales training, certification sponsorships, and accelerated career paths.


**From The Tsaaro Team**
 “At Tsaaro, account management isn’t just about renewals — it’s about building trust, enabling client success, and being a strategic partner. As an Account Manager, you’ll play a key role in shaping how organizations adopt privacy and cybersecurity practices.”
   

  

**Ready to Build Client Success and Drive Strategic Growth?**
 Apply now and be part of Tsaaro’s mission to strengthen privacy, governance, and cybersecurity across the globe.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 EidelHawk Pharma is dedicated to advancing healthcare by delivering high\-quality pharmaceutical solutions grounded in integrity, innovation, and excellence. The organization focuses on providing reliable and affordable medicines while fostering strong partnerships with healthcare professionals, distributors, and business associates. With a commitment to strict quality standards and ethical practices, EidelHawk Pharma aims to support healthier communities and improve patient outcomes. Continuous improvement and long\-term value creation are central to the company’s vision, making it a dynamic environment for professionals seeking purposeful work in the pharmaceutical sector.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Area Sales Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Sikar, responsible for driving sales growth and market expansion for EidelHawk Pharma’s product portfolio within the assigned territory. Daily responsibilities include visiting healthcare professionals and distributors, presenting and promoting pharmaceutical products, and ensuring effective coverage of key accounts. The role involves planning and executing territory sales strategies, monitoring sales performance, and analyzing market trends and competitor activities. The Area Sales Manager will collaborate closely with internal teams for demand forecasting, inventory coordination, and promotional activities, while maintaining accurate records of field activities, customer interactions, and sales reports. The position also requires regular participation in training programs, promotional events, and review meetings to align with company objectives and compliance standards.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong sales and business development skills, including territory management, relationship building, and negotiation capabilities.
* Candidates should possess communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present products clearly, engage diverse stakeholders, and maintain professional relationships.
* Candidates should possess planning, organizing, and analytical skills, including the ability to set targets, track performance, and interpret market and customer data.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of pharmaceutical products, industry regulations, and ethical sales practices, or be willing to learn and adapt quickly.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in basic computer and reporting tools, including spreadsheets, presentation software, and CRM or sales tracking systems.
* Relevant experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare sales, preferably in a similar territory or role, is highly beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* Ability to work on\-site in Sikar, travel within the assigned area, and meet field visit and performance expectations.

title: Sales Manager – Investor Acquisition
description:
**About Mitti Money** 




 Mitti Money is a prop\-tech\-led fractional real estate co\-investment platform enabling investors to co\-own institutional\-grade Delhi NCR properties without buying an entire asset. Built on the vision “Premium land. Every hand,” the platform lets investors co\-invest from as little as ₹10 lakh, earning through quarterly rental distributions and potential capital appreciation, all backed by property\-level SPV structures, registered ownership documentation, and third\-party due diligence.
 



  





 At a glance: ₹200\+ Cr assets under management, 400\+ co\-owners onboarded, and a platform built around access, income, appreciation, and transparency for first\-time investors, working professionals, seasoned investors, and HNIs/family offices alike.
 



  





 As Mitti Money scales its marketing and brand\-building efforts over the next 6 months, we're building out the sales engine to match — converting the leads this push generates into onboarded, invested co\-owners, and driving revenue growth across the platform.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a Sales Manager who will own the last mile of the investor journey — converting leads generated through digital campaigns, influencer content, events, and referrals into paying investors. You'll run the full sales cycle from first conversation to KYC/documentation to funds transfer, while building the relationships and follow\-up discipline needed to grow ticket sizes and repeat investment over time.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Lead Conversion \& Pipeline Management** 




 •     Own inbound leads generated through social media, influencer campaigns, webinars, events, and the website — respond promptly and manage them through a structured sales pipeline.
 



 •     Conduct investor consultations (call/video/in\-person) to understand investment goals, risk appetite, and ticket size, and match them to the right opportunity.
 



 •     Guide prospects through property details, structure (SPV/ownership), expected returns, and risk factors clearly and transparently.
 



 •     Maintain and update lead status, follow\-ups, and conversion data in the CRM; ensure no lead goes cold without a documented reason.
 



  





**Customer Acquisition \& Revenue Growth** 




 •     
 **Own monthly and quarterly investor acquisition and AUM growth targets** 
 — number of new co\-owners onboarded and capital deployed.
 



 •     Drive average ticket size upward through informed conversations, cross\-selling across multiple curated opportunities, and repeat investment from existing co\-owners.
 



 •     Coordinate KYC, documentation, and fund transfer processes with investors, ensuring a smooth and compliant onboarding experience.
 



 •     Build a referral pipeline — encourage satisfied investors to refer working professionals, HNIs, and family offices in their network.
 



  





**Events, Webinars \& On\-Ground Engagement** 




 •     Represent Mitti Money at investor meetups, webinars, corporate hub activations, and press/PR events, converting on\-ground interest into qualified leads.
 



 •     Work closely with the marketing team to close the loop — sharing lead quality feedback to sharpen targeting for future campaigns.
 



 •     Support community engagement (Discord/Telegram, AMAs) by fielding investor questions and nudging engaged members toward investment.
 



  





**Reporting \& Collaboration** 




 •     Track and report on lead\-to\-conversion rates, revenue generated, average ticket size, and investor retention/repeat\-investment rates.
 



 •     Share regular pipeline and forecast updates with founders/leadership.
 



 •     Provide structured feedback to marketing on which channels/campaigns are producing the highest\-quality, most convertible leads.
 



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 •     2–6 years of experience in sales, preferably in real estate, wealth management, fintech, or investment products.
 



 •     Track record of owning and hitting revenue/acquisition targets, not just lead generation — comfortable with the full close.
 



 •     Strong consultative selling skills — able to explain investment structures, risk, and returns clearly to non\-expert investors.
 



 •     Comfort with CRM tools and disciplined pipeline hygiene.
 



 •     Willingness to travel locally for events, meetups, and in\-person investor meetings across Delhi NCR.
 



 •     Bonus: existing network among HNIs, family offices, or working professionals in Tier\-1 cities; familiarity with SPV/fractional ownership structures.
 



  





**Success Metrics You'll Own** 




 •     Number of leads converted to onboarded investors (conversion rate).
 



 •     Revenue generated / capital deployed (AUM growth) per month and quarter.
 



 •     Average investment ticket size.
 



 •     Referral\-driven new investor acquisition.
 




 •     
 
 Investor retention and repeat\-investment rate

description:
About the Role   Introduction
 
 This is a high\-impact opportunity to join Oxford University Press and play a leading role in the growth of the Oxford English Assessment portfolio across India, with a particular focus on the Oxford Test of English (OTE).
 



 As one of Oxford’s strategic growth areas, this role offers the chance to shape market expansion, influence assessment adoption, build meaningful partnerships, and strengthen Oxford’s position within the English language assessment ecosystem. The successful candidate will work with a wide range of stakeholders across education, employability, international mobility, and professional certification sectors while contributing directly to Oxford’s mission of advancing education and learning globally.
 



 This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded professional who enjoys market development, strategic relationship management, business growth, and working within a dynamic, collaborative environment. The role offers significant visibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to make a measurable impact on one of Oxford’s most important growth portfolios.
 


   Opportunity
 
 In this role, you will:
 


   Market Growth \& Commercial Strategy
 
 • Define, implement, and continuously refine the commercial growth strategy for Oxford English Assessment in India, with a primary focus on the Oxford Test of English.
   

 • Develop annual and multi\-year growth plans aligned with global assessment objectives.
   

 • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of opportunities across higher education, vocational education, schools, employers, agents, study\-abroad consultants, and government stakeholders.
   

 • Deliver agreed revenue, test volume, and market\-share targets.
 


   Test Centre Network Development
 
 • Identify, recruit, onboard, and support high\-performing Oxford Test of English Approved Test Centres across India.
   

 • Support the test centre approval process while ensuring compliance with Oxford quality and operational standards.
   

 • Drive test centre productivity through business planning, training, performance reviews, and commercial support.
   

 • Identify opportunities to expand market reach through affiliates, channel partners, and strategic distributors.
 


   Recognition \& Stakeholder Engagement
 
 • Develop relationships with key decision\-makers and influencers across India’s education and employability ecosystem.
   

 • Represent Oxford English Assessment at conferences, policy forums, industry events, and stakeholder meetings.
   

 • Strengthen Oxford’s position as a thought leader in English language assessment and employability.
 


   Sales \& Partner Management
 
 • Develop and execute sales plans for the Oxford Test of English and associated assessment products.
   

 • Manage strategic partnerships and high\-value accounts to maximise adoption and testing volumes.
   

 • Negotiate commercial arrangements within approved authority levels and organisational policies.
   

 • Partner with stakeholders to identify growth opportunities and remove barriers to adoption.
 


   Market Intelligence
 
 • Monitor competitor activity, market trends, regulatory developments, and customer needs.
   

 • Gather and communicate market intelligence to support product development and strategic decision\-making.
   

 • Identify emerging opportunities related to international mobility, graduate employability, higher education admissions, and workforce skills.
 


   Forecasting \& Performance Management
 
 • Prepare accurate sales forecasts, budgets, and business plans.
   

 • Maintain opportunity and customer data within Salesforce and other reporting tools.
   

 • Track performance against agreed KPIs and recommend corrective actions where required.
   

 • Produce regular business reviews and growth reports for leadership teams.
 


   Training \& Internal Collaboration
 
 • Deliver effective assessment product training to internal teams, partners, and customers.
   

 • Work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, and operations teams to ensure successful implementation of growth initiatives.
   

 • Act as the India market expert for Oxford English Assessment.
 



  
 



**Impact of the Role** 




 This role is critical to expanding Oxford English Assessment across India and establishing the Oxford Test of English as a preferred English proficiency assessment. The successful candidate will drive revenue growth, increase test volumes, expand the approved test centre network, strengthen strategic partnerships, improve market awareness, and contribute directly to Oxford University Press’s long\-term growth strategy in assessment and English language learning.
 


   About You   Essential Criteria
 
 • 5\+ years of experience in business development, enterprise sales, channel management, or strategic partnerships.
   

 • Demonstrated success in delivering commercial growth and revenue targets.
   

 • Experience within education, English language learning, assessment, certification, EdTech, study abroad, or related sectors.
   

 • Strong understanding of the Indian higher education and/or English language learning and assessment market.
   

 • Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively across cross\-functional teams.
   

 • Demonstrable track record in key account management or assessment\-related sales roles.
   

 • Proven record of achieving sales targets and driving revenue growth.
   

 • Dynamic self\-starter with strong commercial acumen and stakeholder management skills.
   

 • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
   

 • Fluent English language proficiency.
   

 • Excellent organisational, analytical, and structured decision\-making capabilities.
   

 • Full, clean driving licence.
 


   Desirable Criteria
 
 • Experience working with English language assessment products or testing organisations.
   

 • Experience managing strategic partnerships across education and employability sectors.
   

 • Exposure to international education, student mobility, certification, or workforce skills initiatives.
   

 • Experience engaging with government bodies, higher education institutions, or industry associations.

**Algoaide** 
 is a modern SaaS platform built for the
 **Transport \& Logistics industry** 
 .
 



 We help fleet owners and logistics companies manage their operations, finance, fleet, drivers, customers and other business processes in one platform. We are also building

 to reduce manual work in logistics.
 



 We are now looking for
 **fresh, energetic and hardworking talent** 
 who wants to build a career in
 **Sales \& Business Development** 
 .
 



 This is a great opportunity for someone who is more interested in
 **earning through performance and incentives**

 What You Will Do
 
 You will work directly on the front line of UniZR's sales growth.
 


* Find potential customers in the
 **Transport \& Logistics industry** 
 .
* Make
 **cold calls**

* Schedule meetings with potential customers.
* Attend
 **F2F client meetings** 
 with the team and gradually handle meetings independently.
* Demonstrate Algoaide to potential customers after proper product training.
* Follow up with prospects regularly.
* Convert qualified leads into paying customers.
* Maintain lead and follow\-up information in the CRM.
* Work towards monthly sales targets.
* Build relationships with customers and generate referrals.


 The Sales Journey
 
 You will learn and eventually manage the complete process:
 



**Lead Generation → Cold Call → Qualification → Meeting → Demo → Follow\-up → Negotiation → Sale** 



 Who Are We Looking For?
 
 We are specifically looking for
 **fresh talent** 
 , so prior sales experience is
 **not mandatory** 
 .
 



 You could be:
 


* A recent graduate looking for your first opportunity.
* A college student looking for a sales internship.
* Someone with 0–1 year of experience who wants to enter B2B sales.
* Someone who is confident talking to new people.
* Someone who enjoys meeting customers and travelling locally for business meetings.
* Someone who is highly motivated by
 **performance and earning potential** 
 .


 Most Important: Your Attitude
 
 We are not looking for a candidate with a long resume.
 



 We are looking for someone who is:
 



**Hungry to learn.** 




**Comfortable talking to strangers.** 




**Not afraid of rejection.** 




**Hardworking.** 




**Consistent with follow\-ups.** 




**Interested in earning based on performance.** 




**If you can make 50 calls, hear "No" 45 times, and still make the next 5 calls with the same energy — you could be a good fit for this role.** 



 Compensation Model
 
 This role is designed for candidates who are interested in
 **performance\-based earning** 
 .

 We offer:
 



**Small Fixed Stipend \+ Attractive Commission on Successful Sales** 




**The major earning opportunity comes from sales incentives/commission** 
 .
 



 There is
 **no fixed upper limit on incentive earnings**

 For the right candidate, this can become significantly more rewarding than a traditional fixed\-salary sales role.
 



*The exact incentive structure will be discussed during the interview.*

 This is not just a calling job.
 



 You will learn:
 


* B2B Sales

* Lead Generation
* Customer Qualification
* SaaS Product Sales
* Product Demonstration
* Client Communication
* Negotiation
* Closing Techniques
* CRM \& Sales Pipeline Management
* Transport \& Logistics Industry
* AI \& SaaS Business Models



 You will get the opportunity to work directly with the
 **UniZR team and leadership** 
 and understand how a B2B SaaS business is built and sold.
 


 Why Join UniZR?
 
 If you are a fresher, this role can give you something that many entry\-level jobs don't:
 



**Real responsibility. Real customers. Real meetings. Real sales. Real earning potential.** 




**You won't be sitting in an office doing repetitive work all day.** 




**You will be talking to business owners, understanding their problems, presenting technology solutions and learning how to close real B2B deals.**

**This may not be the right opportunity.**

 RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI\-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 16,000\+ customers and 700\+ partners in 100\+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion.
   

  

 RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta\-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
   

  

 Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 33 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 25 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
   

  

**Product:**
**AirGain**
 AirGain is an AI\-powered airfare pricing intelligence platform by RateGain that helps airlines optimize revenue through real\-time competitive pricing insights. It enables revenue and commercial teams to track fare movements across airlines and channels, make data\-driven pricing decisions, and respond quickly to market changes to maximize profitability.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Inside Sales Executive will be responsible for driving pipeline generation and supporting enterprise sales through a strategic Account\-Based Marketing (ABM) approach across global airline accounts.
   

  

 Reporting to the Sales Director, the role combines the responsibilities of an SDR and Inside Sales Executive, focusing on prospecting, lead qualification, account penetration, and opportunity progression.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Generate qualified pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting and ABM campaigns across airlines, OTAs, and travel technology companies.
* Identify and engage senior stakeholders across Pricing, Revenue Management, Commercial, Distribution, Digital, Procurement, and IT.
* Build and execute strategic account plans for assigned airlines, increasing account penetration and stakeholder coverage.
* Qualify opportunities using MEDDPICC/BANT and transition qualified opportunities to the Sales Director.
* Schedule discovery calls, product demonstrations, workshops, and executive meetings.
* Conduct market research to identify airline RFPs, leadership changes, fleet/network expansion, NDC initiatives, and other buying triggers.
* Execute multi\-channel outreach through email, LinkedIn, phone, conferences, webinars, and marketing campaigns.
* Support the Sales Director with proposals, customer research, executive briefing documents, follow\-ups, and opportunity progression.
* Maintain accurate Salesforce records, pipeline forecasts, meeting notes, and activity tracking.
* Work closely with Product Marketing and Marketing to execute campaigns, nurture leads, and maximize conversion.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with prospects, re\-engage dormant opportunities, and drive pipeline velocity.
* Represent AirGain at industry events, webinars, and customer engagements where required.


**Key KPIs**
* Qualified pipeline generated.
* New enterprise opportunities created.
* Executive meetings, demos, and workshops booked.
* Pipeline progression and conversion rates.
* ABM engagement across strategic airline accounts.
* CRM accuracy, forecasting, and sales activity metrics.


**Preferred Experience**
* 2–5 years of experience in SDR, Inside Sales, Business Development, or Enterprise SaaS sales.
* Strong prospecting, qualification, and consultative selling skills.
* Experience selling into airlines, travel technology, or hospitality is highly desirable.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo/ZoomInfo, and sales engagement platforms.


 We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

description:
**About the Company** 




 Skillinabox is one of India's fastest\-growing SkillTech startups, transforming vocational education through hands\-on learning in Fashion Designing, Make\-up Artistry, and future\-ready skills. With a young team of 110\+, we're on a mission to empower learners and expand our presence by launching new experiential centers across India.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Business Development Executive (Inside Sales), you’ll play a key role in driving student admissions, customer acquisition, lead conversion, and revenue growth. You’ll contribute to our Go\-To\-Market (GTM) strategy, help expand our learner community, and support the launch and growth of new experiential centers while delivering an exceptional counselling experience. This is an entrepreneurial role where you’ll work directly with experienced founders while accelerating your career in the SkillTech ecosystem.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Counsel prospective learners through phone calls, video consultations, WhatsApp, and walk\-in interactions.
* Understand learner requirements and recommend suitable Fashion Designing and Make\-up Artistry programs.
* Convert qualified leads into enrollments while consistently achieving monthly sales targets.
* Conduct consultative sales conversations and deliver an outstanding learner experience.
* Manage the complete sales pipeline from lead generation to enrollment using CRM.
* Build strong relationships with prospective learners and ensure timely follow\-ups.
* Collaborate with the Marketing and Product teams to improve customer experience and lead conversion.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales reports, and daily activity updates.
* Contribute towards business expansion and revenue growth.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 1\-3 year of experience in Business Development, Inside Sales, Education Sales, Academic Counselling, Customer Success, Telecalling, Lead Generation, or B2C Sales.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Excellent verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong interpersonal, negotiation, persuasion, and relationship\-building skills.
* Target\-oriented with the ability to work in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment.
* Passionate about Education, Skill Development, Career Counselling, and helping learners achieve their goals.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn and grow.
* Basic knowledge of CRM software, Microsoft Excel, or Google Sheets is an added advantage.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 



* 3 \- 4\.5LPA (Fixed) \+ 1\-2LPA (Variable).
* Your next Appraisal will be in a really short period considering this is a core team position we are hiring for. (4\-10 Months).
* An opportunity to own a part of the firm, having a skin in the game (ESOPS).
* Benefit \- Become a part of the core team and work directly with founders \& the board.
* Start building a team around you helping you move forward in your role.



  





**Last Words** 




 If you’re ambitious, passionate about helping learners succeed, and excited to build your career in a high\-growth startup, you can email us at careers@skillinabox.in. We’d love to hear more about you from you.

**Company Description** 
 RupeeQ, operated by Intuino Business Consulting India Pvt. Ltd., is an online finance marketplace founded in November 2020 that connects consumers and businesses with a wide range of loan products. The platform simplifies access to personal, business, and other loans while helping financial institutions reduce operational costs through automation and efficiency. RupeeQ is driven by a mission to satisfy customers’ financial needs and deliver an instant, seamless, and “wow” experience anytime, anywhere. The company focuses on building long\-term, trust\-based relationships and serving as a reliable financial partner for both small and large needs. Through a personalized, customer\-centric approach, RupeeQ empowers users to make informed financial decisions.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Personal Loan Consultant is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Noida. This role involves guiding customers through the personal loan process, understanding their financial needs, and recommending suitable loan products from RupeeQ’s partner institutions. The consultant will handle loan inquiries, explain eligibility and documentation requirements, collect and verify customer information, and support loan origination from application to disbursal. Daily responsibilities include maintaining accurate records, following compliance and risk guidelines, coordinating with internal teams and lending partners, and ensuring a high standard of customer service. The role also involves meeting performance targets, providing feedback on process improvements, and contributing to a trusted, transparent customer experience.
   

**Qualifications**
* Experience in loan\-focused roles such as Loan Officers, with exposure to Loans and Loan Origination processes.
* Foundational knowledge in Finance, including understanding of personal loan products, interest rates, and basic credit assessment.
* Strong Customer Service skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, manage queries, and build trust with diverse customers.
* Ability to work with loan documentation, verify information, and adhere to compliance and regulatory standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Comfort using digital tools, CRM systems, and online loan platforms to process applications efficiently.
* Goal\-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple cases, meet timelines, and achieve performance targets.
* Proficiency in English and Hindi, with strong interpersonal and negotiation skills; prior experience in banking, NBFCs, or financial services is an advantage.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
**Role:** 

 Senior Sales Development Representative (SDR)
 




**Company:** 

 GrowthEd
 




**Department:** 

 School Partnerships
 




**Locations:** 

 Rajasthan, Punjab, Uttarakhand, Maharashtra, or Delhi NCR
 




**Work Type:** 

 Field\-based with extensive travel
 




**Experience:** 

 15\+ years
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-time
 




  





  





**About the Company** 





 GrowthEd is an ed\-tech startup imparting life skills education in K\-12 students. Using technology, storytelling and gamification, we are making children financially literate, socially responsible, tech\-competent and real\-world ready. Founded by IITians, GrowthEd currently teaches over 50,000\+ students enrolled across 50\+ schools across India.
 




  





**About the Role** 





 GrowthEd is looking for a well\-connected
 
**Senior Sales Development Representative** 

 to develop school partnerships and drive institutional sales across key markets. This is a senior, relationship\-driven, field\-intensive role requiring continuous travel across the assigned territory.
 





 The role requires an established professional with strong relationships in the K\-12 education industry, particularly with school owners, trustees, principals, directors, and senior management. The candidate will be responsible for generating qualified school opportunities, scheduling meetings for product demonstration, managing post\-demo follow\-ups, negotiating commercials, and taking ownership of closures.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Leverage, build and maintain strong relationships with school owners, trustees, principals, directors, and senior decision\-makers, to identify and engage prospective schools.
* Generate qualified school opportunities and schedule product demonstration meetings.
* Lead follow\-up discussions after Business Development Representative (BDR)\-led product demonstrations, and coordinate with the BDR to ensure smooth handover of school requirements, priorities, and meeting context.
* Participate in important school meetings, presentations, and discussions, and understand school feedback, objections, decision\-making processes, and purchase timelines.
* Own price discussions, commercial negotiations, and contract finalisation with schools.
* Drive opportunities through the complete sales cycle, from initial engagement and meeting coordination to closure and onboarding handover.
* Maintain a strong and updated pipeline of prospective and active school opportunities, ensuring accurate documentation of meetings, discussions, proposals, negotiations, commitments, and next steps.
* Coordinate with the BDR, product, implementation, finance, and leadership teams to resolve school requirements and close opportunities.
* Share market intelligence, competitor insights, customer feedback, and emerging opportunities with the leadership team.
* Travel extensively and continuously across the assigned territory to build relationships and close school partnerships.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



* 15\+ years of experience in sales, business development or partnerships with schools.
* Strong existing connections with school owners, trustees, principals, directors, and K\-12 education groups.
* Proven experience in B2B, institutional, or EdTech sales, and comfort in managing long sales cycles that involve multiple stakeholders.
* Strong commercial understanding with the ability to discuss pricing and value confidently, and demonstrated success in managing negotiations and closing high\-value deals.
* Strong understanding of the school education ecosystem and decision\-making processes.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Self\-driven, target\-oriented, and capable of working independently.
* Strong local knowledge and professional network in at least one of the target markets, and comfort with continuous field travel across the assigned regions.



  





**Preferred Locations** 





 GrowthEd is primarily hiring candidates based in or having strong networks across:
 



* Rajasthan
* Punjab
* Uttarakhand
* Maharashtra
* Delhi NCR




 Candidates with an established education\-sector network in multiple locations will be preferred.

 Warmly welcome and assist B2B clients, designers, and corporate visitors visiting our Noida display centre; walk them through product samples, demonstrate eco\-friendly cork applications, and convert walk\-ins into qualified opportunities.

 Understand customized cork product requirements, prepare tailored commercial quotes, negotiate pricing, and close deals.

 Collaborate closely with internal manufacturing, logistics, and design teams to ensure accurate custom order fulfillment and reliable on\-time delivery.

* **Experience:** 
 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in B2B sales development or field sales, preferably within eco\-friendly products, interior materials, or manufacturing sectors.



  





**Core Competencies:** 




  




* **Lead Generation \& Prospecting:** 
 Proven track record in outbound prospecting, cold outreach, and managing an end\-to\-end sales pipeline.
* **In\-Person Client Handling:** 
 Demonstrated experience in hosting corporate clients, architects, designers, or walk\-in visitors in a showroom or display centre environment.
* **Exhibition Sales:** 
 Experience representing brands at industrial B2B trade shows and converting event leads into revenue.
* **Mobility \& Location:** 
 Based in or willing to commute daily to Noida, with flexibility to travel pan\-India for client visits and trade exhibitions.
* **Skills:** 
 Strong negotiation, presentation, and communication skills (English and Hindi); familiarity with CRM software and pipeline tracking tools.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field (MBA is a plus).

title: Technical Integration Manager - Pre-Sales | API Integration | Access Control | NOIDA
description:
**Designation:** 
**Technical Integration Manager \| Partner Alliance \| Pre\-Sales** 




**Experience: 8 to 10 years** 




**Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related field** 




**Department: Presales \& Partner Alliances** 




**Reports To: Associate Director \- Partner Alliances** 




**Location: Noida** 




  





**Company Profile** 




  





 Founded in 2005, IDCUBE Identification Systems Private Limited is a global software company with offices in the USA, UAE, Malaysia, and India. We specialize in delivering on\-premises and cloud\-based physical security platforms trusted by distributors and system integrators worldwide.
 



  





 With 4500\+ successful deployments across 20\+ countries, IDCUBE simplifies and unifies the highly fragmented physical security landscape through an integrated and cost\-effective approach.
 



  





 Our next\-generation cloud\-native platform (Access360 / Access360 AI) leverages AI\-driven access control, real\-time insights, and modern microservices architecture. As we scale globally, we are strengthening our database reliability, security, and performance footprint across on\-prem and cloud deployments.
 



  





**Summary** 




  





 The Technical Manager \- Partner Alliances owns the technical execution, validation, and ongoing health of all integrations delivered through outsourced vendors and technology partners. This role sits at the technical core of the Partner Alliances function \- setting up and configuring third\-party integrations, validating that delivered work meets functional, security, and design standards, maintaining compatibility as partner applications evolve, and enabling internal teams to represent these integrations confidently to customers.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibility** 




  




* Define the integration method (API, SDK, or Webhook) for each new project.
* Assess the technical feasibility of the proposed integration scope.
* Identify and flag Product enhancement requirements to the internal Software team.
* Handle the hands\-on setup, configuration, and enablement of integrations across multiple technology systems.
* Coordinate with internal API and Product teams to ensure required APIs, environments, and access are available before integration activities begin.
* Validate integrations developed by outsourced vendors and technology partners against defined functional and technical specifications before go\-live.
* Track the latest versions of integrated third\-party applications and assess backward compatibility. Proactively identify and recommend upgrades required for existing integrations.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, brochures, and demo videos for working integrations.
* Conduct hands\-on training for Presales and Customer Success teams on integration capabilities and usage.



  





**Knowledge and Skills Required** 




  




* Understanding of how software integrations work and hands\-on knowledge of integration methodologies \- APIs (REST/SOAP), SDKs, and Webhooks.
* Working knowledge of API security concepts (OAuth, API keys, token\-based auth) and general web application architecture.
* Understanding of UI/UX guidelines sufficient to validate third\-party or vendor\-built integration interfaces against internal design standards.
* Ability to independently test integrations as well as review technical documentation and architecture.
* A strong written and verbal communication skill \- this role documents technical findings and also trains non\-technical internal teams.
* Comfortable working across multiple concurrent projects with vendors, technology partners, and internal engineering teams.



  





**Experience and Education:** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related field
* 8\-10 years of experience in a technical integration, solutions engineering, technical presales, or API implementation role.
* Experience working with operating systems (Windows, Linux), databases (MS SQL \& PostgreSQL), installation, configuration, and setup of multiple software Applications.
* Prior experience working with software vendors or technology partners is preferred.
* Exposure to physical/logical access control and other security software (VMS, Intercom, BMS, etc) or enterprise SaaS integrations is a plus.

Swiggy is India's leading on\-demand delivery platform with a tech\-first approach to logistics and a solution\-first approach to consumer demands. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. **Overview**
**Job Description**
 A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single\-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants—learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

* Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners

* Data\-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course\-correct
* Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates

**About the Company** 





 AMRS Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. is a professionally managed pharmaceutical manufacturing and export conglomerate with a strong presence in International and Indian market.
 




  






 At AMRS Healthcare Pvt. Ltd., we are committed to enriching lives and making a meaningful difference to patients. Our continuous efforts focus on the development of advanced therapies aimed at improving health outcomes and enhancing the quality of life for Global citizens.
 




  





 With 30\+ years of experience in the industry AMRS Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. stakeholders founded the company in 2015 and has rapidly emerged as a trusted name in the Global Pharmaceutical Industry.
 



  





 Our manufacturing facilities manufacture medicines in dosage forms like Injections, Tablets, Capsules, Ointments \& Creams, Soft Gelatin Capsules, Syrups, Dry Syrups and Eye Drops in therapeutic segments like Cardiovascular, Diabetes, Immunology, Tuberculosis, Neurology, Ophthalmology, Nephrology, Gynecology and Oncology for human usage and we also manufacture veterinary medicines.
 



  





 We are a growth\-oriented organization, and we always encourage our existing employees to grow their careers with us and employees can get their placements in our overseas offices in Colombia, Mexico and Dubai.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic professional for the post of
 **Business Development Executive (BDE)**

 The candidate will also be responsible for identifying potential clients, generating leads, building customer relationships, and supporting the complete sales process from inquiry, purchase order confirmation and dispatch of the products.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Identify pharmaceutical companies requiring third\-party manufacturing services.
* Generate new business leads though online portals, email, and social media.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients.
* Explain the company's manufacturing capabilities, product range, certifications, and services.
* Follow up on customer inquiries and convert them into business opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal departments for quotations, product availability, documentation, and order processing.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions, and daily activities in Excel.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
