* Good convincing and presentation skills.
* Knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, MS Power point and Email.
* Ability to learn quickly and work in a target\-driven environment.
* Team player with strong organizational skills.







**Preferred Skills** 



* Basic understanding of the pharmaceutical industry.
* Knowledge of Domestic Third\-Party Manufacturing or Pharma Marketing is preferred but not mandatory.
* Fluency in English, both verbal and written.







**What We Offer** 



* Comprehensive training on pharmaceutical products and third\-party manufacturing.
* Attractive fixed salary and performance linked incentives.
* Un\-matched career growth opportunities.
* Professional and supportive work environment.
* Skill development and continuous learning.
* Opportunity to work with clients across India.
* Placement in our overseas offices in Colombia, Mexico and Dubai.







**Why Join AMRS Healthcare?**

**Company Description** 
 Think Exam, a Ginger Webs Company, is a global leader in AI\-enabled assessment solutions that help organizations modernize and streamline their talent evaluation processes. With 18\+ years of domain experience and more than 3,500 clients across India and worldwide, Think Exam supports businesses in talent acquisition, campus hiring, and talent development. The company’s comprehensive suite of tools includes online examinations, skill evaluations, psychometric assessments, and surveys, all designed to be accessible, secure, and user\-friendly. Backed by robust security measures, secure servers, and strict access controls, Think Exam provides a safe and reliable environment for all assessment activities. Known for its commitment to innovation and excellence, Think Exam is a trusted partner for businesses seeking to optimize and scale their assessment practices.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Junior Enterprise Sales role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Noida. This role involves identifying and qualifying potential corporate clients, conducting outreach through calls, emails, and meetings, and supporting the end\-to\-end sales cycle for Think Exam’s assessment solutions. The Junior Enterprise Sales professional will assist in preparing proposals, demos, and presentations, coordinate with internal teams to address client requirements, and maintain accurate records in the CRM system. Day\-to\-day responsibilities also include market research, following up on leads, nurturing relationships with prospects, and contributing to achieving revenue and growth targets. The role requires close collaboration with senior sales team members to learn best practices, refine sales strategies, and deliver a high\-quality client experience.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with corporate clients and internal stakeholders.
* Basic understanding of B2B sales, lead generation, and account management, preferably within SaaS, technology, or assessment solutions.
* Ability to conduct market research, analyze client needs, and present solutions clearly and persuasively.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, productivity software, and online collaboration platforms to manage pipelines and sales activities.
* High level of motivation, a goal\-oriented mindset, and readiness to learn from mentorship and feedback in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field; prior internship or up to 2 years of experience in sales or business development is an advantage.
* Professional fluency in English; proficiency in Hindi or additional languages is beneficial for client interactions in India.
* Interest in HR tech, assessments, or edtech, and willingness to stay updated on industry trends and product developments.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**About AdClear** 

 AdClear is a Google Partner performance marketing agency. Our clients include Hindustan Times, CNBC TV18, Moneycontrol, The Hindu, HDFC Sky, Accenture and upGrad Enterprise. We've built a strong base in India; the next chapter is international, and we're hiring someone to own it.
 


**The Role** 

 This is an independent, end\-to\-end business development role with a clear mandate: bring in international clients. You'll build the pipeline, run the pitch, close the deal and hand it over cleanly to delivery. You'll work directly with the founders, but you won't be waiting on them — you own the number.
 


**What You'll Do** 

 •   Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, outreach, discovery, proposal, pitch, negotiation, close
 



 •   Open and grow international accounts — UAE, UK, US, SEA, or whichever markets you know best
 



 •   Build a pipeline across any industry where performance marketing drives revenue; we're not limited to our current verticals
 



 •   Scope and price performance marketing, SEO and creative engagements with the delivery team
 



 •   Write proposals and SOWs that win, not decks that get filed
 



 •   Attend industry events, run outbound campaigns, and turn referrals into revenue
 



 •   Track pipeline, conversion and revenue in CRM and report weekly to the founders
 



 •   Use AI across the sales cycle — prospect research, outreach, proposal drafting and market intelligence — and build the workflows and automations that make it repeatable
 


**What We're Looking For** 

 •   2–4 years of business development or client acquisition at a digital marketing / performance marketing agency — this is non\-negotiable
 



 •   Proven track record of winning international clients, or an active network in at least one overseas market
 



 •   Comfortable working across time zones and adapting pitches to different markets and buyer cultures
 



 •   Comfortable talking Google Ads, Meta, SEO and analytics with a CMO without a specialist in the room
 



 •   Hands\-on with AI tools beyond basic prompting: you've built AI\-driven workflows or automations for lead gen, outreach or research, and can show what they produced — must\-have
 



 •   Self\-driven: you set targets, chase them, and don't need to be managed day to day
 



 •   Strong written and verbal English; proposal and pitch skills that hold up in front of senior buyers
 



 •   Based in Delhi NCR and able to work hybrid from our Noida office
 


**Why Join** 

 •   Full ownership of a growth role — no layers, direct access to founders
 



 •   Established client roster and case studies that open doors overseas
 



 •   Hybrid working with a remote\-friendly team rhythm
 



 •   Performance\-linked earnings that reward closing, not activity

**About Omnipresent Robot Tech Pvt. Ltd:**

Its solutions have been used in agriculture, surveillance, industrial inspection, mapping, and increasingly in AI\-driven automation and space systems.

Omnipresent is working on developing SAR based satellite for DEM generation, multi\-sensor fusion based AI solutions for onboard satellite payloads \& aviation safety and drone capabilities Today, Omnipresent continues to build cutting\-edge solutions in AI, robotics, drones and space tech, serving both national and global needs while leading India's deep\-tech innovation ecosystem.

 Individual Contributor
 



**Reports to:** 
 VP – Growth \& Marketing / Founder
 



  





**About FoxSuite.ai** 




 FoxSuite.ai is a connected AI business platform built for growing businesses. It brings websites, forms, meetings, customer information, sales processes and business workflows into one connected system, supported by implementation and ongoing assistance.
 



 Our objective is to help businesses reduce disconnected tools, improve customer visibility and build an AI\-enabled operating system suited to their requirements.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are hiring an experienced
 **AI Sales Consultant – Outbound** 
 to acquire mid\-market and enterprise customers across India.
 



  





 You will own the complete sales cycle, including account research, outbound prospecting, discovery, solution design, demonstrations, commercial proposals, negotiation and closure.
 



  





 This is a revenue\-carrying individual\-contributor role for someone who has successfully sold SaaS, CRM, automation or AI\-led technology solutions to founders, CXOs and senior business leaders.
 



 The role requires active prospecting and personal ownership of closures. It is suited to a consultative salesperson who can understand business problems, connect them with the right FoxSuite solution and manage multi\-stakeholder deals through longer sales cycles.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Outbound Prospecting and Account Development** 



* Identify and prioritise high\-potential mid\-market and enterprise accounts across the assigned industries.
* Research target companies, decision\-makers, existing systems, operational challenges and potential use cases.
* Build outbound prospect lists based on the approved ideal customer profiles.
* Generate meetings through calls, email, LinkedIn, referrals, business communities, events and channel relationships.
* Create personalised outreach for CXOs, founders, sales leaders, marketing leaders, operations heads and technology stakeholders.
* Maintain a consistent level of outbound activity while prioritising account quality and commercial potential.



  





**Full\-Cycle Enterprise Sales** 



* Own the complete sales cycle from prospecting through payment and customer handover.
* Conduct structured discovery to understand the customer’s business problems, current technology, workflows, decision process, budget and implementation expectations.
* Qualify opportunities based on business need, authority, commercial fit, urgency and an agreed next step.
* Translate customer requirements into a suitable FoxSuite solution and commercial offer.
* Deliver product demonstrations and solution presentations to senior stakeholders.
* Prepare proposals, business cases, pricing discussions and commercial responses.
* Handle objections, competition, procurement requirements and negotiations.
* Maintain momentum across sales cycles of 30–90 days or longer.
* Close high\-value SaaS and technology deals against agreed quarterly and annual targets.



  





**Pipeline and Revenue Management** 



* Build and maintain a qualified pipeline equal to approximately
 **3–5 times the assigned sales quota** 
 .
* Keep every active opportunity updated in the CRM with its owner, value, stage, expected closure date, stakeholders and next action.
* Maintain accurate weekly, monthly and quarterly forecasts.
* Identify deal risks early and prepare clear actions to address them.
* Report meetings, qualified opportunities, proposals, expected contract value, closures and collections separately.
* Consistently achieve agreed revenue, new\-customer and collection targets.



  





**Internal Solution Coordination** 



* Work closely with product, technology and implementation teams to validate solution fit, scope and delivery timelines.
* Ensure that customer\-facing commitments reflect approved product capabilities.
* Coordinate technical discussions, tailored demonstrations and implementation planning where required.
* Prepare a complete sales\-to\-implementation handover for every customer.
* Communicate customer feedback, objections, competitor information and lost\-deal reasons to the relevant teams.
* Support the customer through contracting, payment and the initial onboarding handover.



  





**Target Market** 




 The primary territory will be
 **India\-based mid\-market and enterprise businesses** 
 .
 



**Priority industries include:** 



* E\-commerce and retail technology
* Healthcare and wellness
* Real estate and property services
* Retail, Logistics and supply chain
* Education and training
* Professional and business services



**Must\-Have Experience** 



* 4–6 years of experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, CRM, automation or AI solution sales.
* A demonstrated record of personally closing mid\-market or enterprise deals.
* Experience owning a sales quota and consistently working towards revenue targets.
* Experience managing sales cycles of 30–90 days or longer.
* Strong experience in both outbound prospecting and deal closure.
* Ability to conduct discovery, product demonstrations, commercial discussions and negotiations independently.
* Experience engaging founders, CXOs and senior functional leaders.
* Strong pipeline management, forecasting and CRM discipline.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to travel for important customer meetings when required.



 Candidates should be prepared to discuss their previous quotas, percentage achievement, average contract value, largest personally closed deal and their specific contribution to those closures.
 



  





**Good\-to\-Have Experience** 



* Experience selling AI\-led business solutions, CRM platforms, communication platforms or workflow automation products.
* Experience selling connected platforms involving more than one product or business function.
* Exposure to multi\-stakeholder enterprise buying processes.
* Familiarity with consultative, solution\-selling or value\-based sales frameworks.
* Experience working with product and implementation teams on customised customer requirements.
* Existing relationships within any of FoxSuite’s priority industries.



  





**Who This Role Is Not Suitable For** 




 This role will not be suitable for:
 


* Candidates whose experience is primarily in retail, showroom or counter sales.
* Profiles without verifiable experience in closing B2B SaaS or enterprise technology deals.
* Candidates whose experience is limited to account management, customer support or relationship servicing.
* Lead\-generation profiles that have not personally managed discovery, negotiation and closure.
* Pure field\-sales profiles without structured SaaS or technology\-selling experience.
* Candidates who depend entirely on inbound leads and do not have hands\-on outbound prospecting experience.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The successful consultant will build a healthy target\-account pipeline, create qualified CXO conversations, maintain disciplined sales execution and convert appropriate opportunities into paid FoxSuite customers.
 



  





 This role is for a salesperson who can open doors, understand complex business requirements, build commercial confidence and take personal ownership of revenue from the first conversation through closure.

 • Act as the primary point of contact for the client during implementation and ongoing delivery
 



 • Track project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation across multiple concurrent client accounts

**Client Relationship \& Account Health** 




  





 •Build strong relationships with school/institution stakeholders (principals, admins, procurement heads)
 



 •Proactively flag risks (delays, resource gaps, quality issues) before they become escalations

**Cross\-functional Coordination** 




  





 •Work with Curriculum team to customize/adapt content for specific client needs

**Skills \-** 
 Strong solutioning/consultative skills — able to translate client needs into a workable, costed proposal \- Excellent presentation and stakeholder communication skills (comfortable pitching to school leadership, procurement teams, or corporate clients) \- Project management skills — able to manage multiple accounts/timelines simultaneously \- Working understanding of Makerspace/STEM lab components (equipment, curriculum, facilitator models) — doesn’t need to be deeply technical, but needs enough fluency to solution credibly \- Comfortable working cross\-functionally across Sales, Curriculum, Operations, and Finance \- Strong problem\-solving skills — able to unblock delivery issues quickly

title: Business Development Executive- B2B
description:
**1\. Role Purpose** 




 This is a high\-ownership, individual\-contributor sales role focused on identifying, pitching, and converting new manufacturer and brand clients onto the AppointDistributors.com platform. The person will own the complete new\-client acquisition cycle — from prospecting to onboarding — and is expected to be a self\-driven closer, not just a lead follow\-up executive.
 



**2\. What Success Looks Like** 




 •    New client acquisition targets are met or exceeded every month with a healthy, well\-qualified pipeline.
 



 •    Leads are contacted, pitched, and followed up within agreed SLAs with no leakage.
 



 •    Client onboarding (profile, listing, category tagging) is completed accurately and promptly after every conversion.
 



 •    CRM records are current, complete, and reflect true lead/client status at all times.
 



 •    Client communication is professional, brand\-aligned, and builds trust from the first interaction.
 



 •    Revenue from new client acquisition grows consistently month over month.
 



**3\. Key Responsibilities – Prospecting \& Lead Generation** 




 •    Identify and build a pipeline of prospective manufacturers/brands seeking distributor networks across assigned categories/regions.
 



 •    Work assigned inbound leads (website inquiries, ads, referrals) as well as self\-sourced outbound leads.
 



 •    Research target companies and decision\-makers to personalize outreach and improve connect rates.
 



 •    Maintain a steady daily/weekly outreach volume (calls, email, WhatsApp) in line with targets.
 



**4\. Key Responsibilities – Client Pitching \& Conversion** 




 •    Pitch platform membership plans (registration, premium listings, lead access) clearly and persuasively.
 



 •    Understand each prospect's requirement — product category, budget, target region — and position the right plan.
 



 •    Handle objections, pricing negotiations, and follow\-ups professionally to close conversions.
 



 •    Coordinate with the reporting manager on pricing exceptions or non\-standard deal terms.
 



 •    Meet individual monthly acquisition, conversion, and revenue targets.
 



**5\. Key Responsibilities – Onboarding \& Handover** 




 •    Set up new client company profiles, product listings, and category tagging accurately upon conversion.
 



 •    Ensure all onboarding documentation and payment/registration formalities are completed without delay.
 



 •    Brief the new client on how to use the platform, respond to leads, and get the most value from their plan.
 



 •    Hand over onboarded clients to the EC (Existing Client) Division with complete, documented context.
 



**6\. Key Responsibilities – CRM, Reporting \& Coordination** 




 •    Maintain accurate, real\-time CRM records of every lead, follow\-up, conversion, and lost\-deal reason.
 



 •    Share regular pipeline and conversion reports with the reporting manager.
 



 •    Coordinate with the marketing team on lead quality, source performance, and campaign feedback.
 



 •    Flag recurring objections or market feedback that could inform pricing, product, or marketing decisions.
 



**7\. Required Competencies** 




 •    Strong ownership mindset with a genuine drive to hit and exceed sales targets.
 



 •    Excellent verbal and written communication in Hindi and English.
 



 •    Confident, persistent, and comfortable with outbound/cold outreach.
 



 •    Good listening and needs\-assessment ability to pitch the right plan to the right prospect.
 



 •    Basic CRM and Excel/Google Sheets proficiency.
 



 •    High follow\-up discipline and ability to manage a multi\-stage pipeline independently.
 


* •    Resilience to handle rejection and sustain performance in a target\-driven environment.
